'''Tarnith Station''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]. Maintained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the era of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later it served as a front-line observation platform from which [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] advisers and [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] alike monitored the situation along the [[Mandalorian Wars]]' [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]] security cordon.

==Description==
Tarnith Station was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Tarnith system/Legends|Tarnith system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:JebbleVanquoTarnithLine-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tarnith Station was used by the Galactic Republic to observe the battlefront along the Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line (pictured).]]
Tarnith Station was maintained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the era of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="CSWE" /> of [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[3966 BBY/Legends|Thirty years]] later,<ref name="3966 BBY">"[[The Taris Holofeed: Siege Edition]]," which establishes that the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorians]] began threatening [[Tarnith]] three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, was included in [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]], the events of which the issue itself and the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' date to [[3963 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, as part of its [[Mandalorian Wars|campaign of expansion]] throughout the Outer Rim,<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> began threatening the Tarnith [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Tarnith]], one of the resource [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The Republic extended membership to Taris and pledged to protect it,<ref name="Siege Edition">{{KOTORbackups|15}}</ref> establishing a protective security cordon known as the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]]<ref name="TEA" /> that became a front line in the conflict between the Republic and the Mandalorians.<ref name="Prime Edition">{{KOTORbackups|0}}</ref>

During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Tarnith Station served as a front-line observation platform, which was used by both advisers of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] to monitor the progress of<ref name="CSWE" /> the ongoing skirmishes. Around [[3964 BBY]], the [[Taris Holofeed]] issued a news report from Tarnith Station that noted the recent inconclusive [[Fourth battle of Suurja|fourth battle]] between the Republic and the Mandalorians at the world [[Suurja]] on the Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line.<ref name="Prime Edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarnith Station was first mentioned in "[[The Taris Holofeed: Prime Edition]]"&mdash;a representation of an [[in-universe]] news [[Media/Legends|media]] issue that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published within [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion flip-book|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion'' flip-book]]<ref name="Prime Edition" /> on [[March 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-539/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-Rebellion-Flip-Book|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion Flip Book}}</ref> The capitalization of the station's name was subsequently provided by [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tarnith system, and thereby the station, in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
